name: DS Cluster S10e Intraday: Typed Resample Variants (1Min/5Min ↔ 1H/1D)
description: Intraday companion to ds_cluster_S10e. Tests typed resample dispatch on 1Min foundation data: downsample 1Min→1H→1D on numeric/boolean/timestamp, upsample 1H→1Min on numeric/boolean. Exercises the RTH session-aware time bucketing path and the tuple→scalar resolver fallback that motivated the rewrite.
source:
# =============================================================================
# DS CLUSTER S10e INTRADAY: Typed Resample Variants (1Min/5Min foundation)
# =============================================================================
# Intraday companion to ds_cluster_S10e. All data starts at 1Min (Intraday
# foundation) and is resampled up to 1H/1D to exercise the session-aware
# time bucketing path on every supported type.

src = study_assets()
close = src.c
ts = index().value  # 1Min bar timestamps (Intraday foundation)

# === Numeric downsample — 1Min → 1H (downsample_number) ===
hourly_close = resample(close, target_timeframe=1H, agg=["Last"])
hourly_mean = resample(close, target_timeframe=1H, agg=["Mean"])
hourly_high = resample(src.h, target_timeframe=1H, agg=["Max"])
hourly_low = resample(src.l, target_timeframe=1H, agg=["Min"])

# === Numeric downsample — 1Min → 1D (two-level: exercises the calendar grid) ===
daily_close_from_1min = resample(close, target_timeframe=1D, agg=["Last"])

# === Boolean downsample — session-mask → 1H ===
# Derive a boolean from datetime_extract at the 1Min grid, then downsample.
# 'Asian session': 00:00–09:00 UTC on the 1Min bar.
hour_utc = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.hour, timezone="UTC")(ts)
is_asian = hour_utc >= 0 and hour_utc < 9
is_us = hour_utc >= 13 and hour_utc < 20

# Did any Asian-session bar occur in each hour? (Any)
hourly_any_asian = resample(is_asian, target_timeframe=1H, agg=["Any"])
# Are ALL bars in each hour US-session bars? (All)
hourly_all_us = resample(is_us, target_timeframe=1H, agg=["All"])

# === Timestamp downsample — 1Min bar timestamp → 1H ===
# Classic I5-036 pattern: control compute grid timeframe explicitly by
# taking the last 1Min timestamp in each hour.
hourly_bar_ts = resample(ts, target_timeframe=1H, agg=["Last"])

# Also go one step further: 1H → 1D on the already-downsampled timestamp,
# exercising a chained downsample_timestamp pipeline.
daily_bar_ts = resample(hourly_bar_ts, target_timeframe=1D, agg=["Last"])

# === Numeric upsample — 1H → 1Min (upsample_number) ===
# Upsample hourly_close back to 1Min via ffill; every 1Min bar inside an
# hour carries the prior hourly close.
close_ffill_1min = resample(hourly_close, target_timeframe=1Min, how="ffill")

# === Boolean upsample — 1H → 1Min (upsample_boolean) ===
# Carry the hourly 'any_asian' flag down to every 1Min bar.
# This is the critical path: hourly_any_asian is a BoolTuple (output of
# downsample_boolean), fed into upsample which declares scalar Boolean —
# exercises the tuple→scalar resolver fallback in generic_function_resolver.h.
any_asian_1min = resample(hourly_any_asian, target_timeframe=1Min, how="ffill")

# === REPORTERS ===
# Numeric: hourly OHLC
xy_lines(
    title="Hourly OHLC from 1Min Resample",
    category="Typed Resample Intraday",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Hourly Close", color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Hourly High", color=Color.Green),
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Hourly Low", color=Color.Red)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=(hourly_close, hourly_high, hourly_low))

xy_lines(
    title="Hourly Mean Close",
    category="Typed Resample Intraday",
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name="Hourly Mean", color=Color.Cyan)
    ])
)(x_values=index(), y_values=hourly_mean)

# Sink boolean/timestamp/upsample outputs so every typed variant actually runs.
cards(
    category="Typed Resample Intraday",
    layout=CardLayout(title="Hourly Any-Asian Flag (downsample_boolean)", cells=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Any Asian", card_agg=AggregationType.Any, type=CardRenderType.TextFormat)
    ])
)(hourly_any_asian)

cards(
    category="Typed Resample Intraday",
    layout=CardLayout(title="Hourly All-US Flag (downsample_boolean)", cells=[
        ColumnSpec(title="All US", card_agg=AggregationType.All, type=CardRenderType.TextFormat)
    ])
)(hourly_all_us)

cards(
    category="Typed Resample Intraday",
    layout=CardLayout(title="Hourly Bar Timestamp (downsample_timestamp)", cells=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Last Bar TS", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DateFormat)
    ])
)(hourly_bar_ts)

cards(
    category="Typed Resample Intraday",
    layout=CardLayout(title="Daily Bar Timestamp (chained ts downsample)", cells=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Last Bar TS", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DateFormat)
    ])
)(daily_bar_ts)

cards(
    category="Typed Resample Intraday",
    layout=CardLayout(title="Daily Close (1Min→1D numeric)", cells=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Daily Close", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
    ])
)(daily_close_from_1min)

cards(
    category="Typed Resample Intraday",
    layout=CardLayout(title="Close ffill 1H→1Min (upsample_number)", cells=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Close (1Min ffill)", card_agg=AggregationType.Last, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat, dp=2)
    ])
)(close_ffill_1min)

cards(
    category="Typed Resample Intraday",
    layout=CardLayout(title="Any-Asian 1Min Carry (upsample_boolean)", cells=[
        ColumnSpec(title="Any Asian (1Min)", card_agg=AggregationType.Any, type=CardRenderType.TextFormat)
    ])
)(any_asian_1min)
